name: nf-employment-pay
description: Establish selected Norfolk Island employment pay standards before computing payroll. Covers Fair Work coverage and ongoing island modifications, award and agreement selection, the 2026 national minimum wage, ordinary hours, selected leave, notice, redundancy, deductions, payslip content and employee records. Use for Norfolk wage floors, leave balances, final pay, pay frequency or payslip questions. Includes primary legislation, the wage order, fictional components and boundary checks. Separates employment entitlements from PAYG and super, preserves historical service and privacy conditions, and holds unresolved instruments and special cases. This source-cited reference does not complete payroll outputs or the country pack.
